phase: Cause-line protocol, Lite LOW. Genuine unconditional exception bug retained with full propagation fix; wrong-model target missed.

verification_decisions.reason: The inclusion of 'or True' in the conditional check makes the exception handler trigger unconditionally for any exception, breaking the intended logic of checking token limits and disrupting parallel research.

findings.title: Unconditional exception handler prematurely terminates research phase on any transient error
findings.impact: Any transient error (such as a temporary network timeout, rate limit, or search tool failure) during parallel sub-researcher execution causes the supervisor to immediately abort the entire research workflow and jump to END.
findings.preconditions: An exception is raised during `asyncio.gather(*research_tasks)` in `supervisor_tools`.
findings.explanation: The boolean expression `if is_token_limit_exceeded(e, configurable.research_model) or True:` evaluates to `True` unconditionally due to `or True`, bypassing intended error differentiation and prematurely ending research.
